name: MH-Z19 NDIR CO₂ Sensor
description: Non-dispersive infrared CO₂ sensor measuring 400–5000 ppm with ±50 ppm accuracy. UART or PWM interface. Built-in temperature compensation and auto-calibration. Ideal for indoor air quality and ventilation control.

autoCalibrate.description: ABC auto-calibration assumes 400 ppm baseline every 24 hours

firmwareHint: Use MHZ19 library by Tobias Schürg. Disable ABC auto-calibration in enclosed spaces. Allow 3-minute warmup before first reading.
